parameters.name: Attribute
parameters.description:
The property of the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). Valid values:

attachment: queries the attachment information of member network interface controllers (NICs) for a trunk network interface controller (NIC). This parameter is in invitational preview and is not available for use.

connectionTrackingConfiguration: queries the network connectivity tracking configuration.

Default value:

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the network interface controller (NIC). You can invoke [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.description: > This parameter is not available for use.
